{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored blazer, single-breasted, hip length, mid grey (#8A8D91), wool-blend suiting with a subtle texture

Tailored trousers, straight leg, full length to the ankle, matching mid grey (#8A8D91), wool-blend suiting

Blouse, relaxed fit with a soft collar, hip length, deep burgundy (#6B1E2E), matte crepe

Ankle boots, low block heel, almond toe, black (#1A1A1A), smooth leather

Earrings, medium-sized sculptural drops, silver (#C0C0C0), polished metal

Belt, slim, black (#1A1A1A), smooth leather with a silver buckle (#C0C0C0)

Why this outfit works: The grey suit you asked for is cut as a matching blazer and trousers, and its slight texture keeps it neat and appropriate for the workplace in autumn. The deep burgundy blouse adds warmth and richness that suit your coloring, while the black boots and belt ground the look and keep it polished. The silver earrings give the accent in your jewelry that you wanted and stand out against the dark hair and the burgundy collar. The straight trousers and the hip-length blazer create a balanced, clean line that is comfortable through a full working day."}
